title: Time-Delayed Transformers for Data-Driven Modeling of Low-Dimensional Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2602.08478v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose the time-delayed transformer (TD-TF), a simplified transformer architecture for data-driven modeling of unsteady spatio-temporal dynamics. TD-TF bridges linear operator-based methods and deep sequence models by showing that a single-layer, single-head transformer can be interpreted as a nonlinear generalization of time-delayed dynamic mode decomposition (TD-DMD). The architecture is deliberately minimal, consisting of one self-attention layer with a single query per prediction and one feedforward layer, resulting in linear computational complexity in sequence length and a small parameter count. Numerical experiments demonstrate that TD-TF matches the performance of strong linear baselines on near-linear systems, while significantly outperforming them in nonlinear and chaotic regimes, where it accurately captures long-term dynamics. translated_title: 用于低维动力学数据驱动建模的时滞Transformer
translated_abstract: 我们提出了时滞Transformer（TD-TF），这是一种用于非定常时空动力学数据驱动建模的简化Transformer架构。TD-TF在基于线性算子的方法与深度序列模型之间架起了桥梁，证明单层、单头的Transformer可以被解释为时滞动态模态分解（TD-DMD）的非线性推广。该架构刻意保持极简，仅由一个自注意力层（每次预测只使用单个查询）和一个前馈层组成，从而使计算复杂度随序列长度线性增长，且参数量很小。数值实验表明，TD-TF在近线性系统上与强线性基线方法的性能相当，而在非线性和混沌状态下则显著优于这些基线，并能准确捕捉长期动力学特性。在合成信号、非定常空气动力学、Lorenz '63系统等验证研究中的结果表明……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种极简的单层单头时滞Transformer（TD-TF），可视为时滞动态模态分解（TD-DMD）的非线性推广，在保持低计算复杂度的同时，在非线性和混沌低维动力学的长期预测中显著优于线性基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the time-delayed transformer (TD-TF), a minimal single-layer, single-head architecture interpretable as a nonlinear generalization of time-delayed DMD, which maintains low computational complexity while significantly outperforming linear baselines in modeling nonlinear and chaotic low-dimensional dynamics.
